label: OpenMAIC
description: Turns a topic or an uploaded document into an interactive class: generated slides, quizzes and simulations delivered by an AI teacher with narration and a live whiteboard. Runs the open-source OpenMAIC courseware engine against this platform's own models.
notes: This rail is a THIN WRAPPER, not the application. OpenMAIC itself is an upstream Next.js 16 app (THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC) that cannot be a federated remote: it owns its own router, middleware and SSR. It runs as a SECOND container, `openmaic-app`, and this rail reverse-proxies it under /openmaic/api/app/ so the gateway's X-Platform-User gate stays in front of it and the iframe is same-origin. terminal-fun's webtoys iframe is the precedent.

The broker is Ollama-native (POST /v1/chat, NDJSON) while OpenMAIC speaks OpenAI-compatible (/v1/chat/completions, SSE). This rail therefore hosts a translation shim at /api/llm/v1 and points OpenMAIC at it. Going direct to Ollama would work but would bypass the broker's GPU gate, letting course generation evict other rails' models off an 8 GB card.

OPENMAIC_LLM_BASE_URL overrides the shim with an external OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. a larger-VRAM host on the LAN). When set, the reasoning chip reports the override rather than broker residency, because the broker is not serving that slot.
